headword: {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}

definitions.explanation: a method of education where students learn without being physically present at a school or institution

examples.japanese: {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}で{学位|がくい}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To earn a degree through distance education.

examples.japanese: {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}のおかげで{地方|ちほう}でも{質|しつ}の{高|たか}い{授業|じゅぎょう}が{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: Thanks to distance education, even people in rural areas can take high-quality classes.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}をきっかけに{遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}が{急速|きゅうそく}に{普及|ふきゅう}し、{大学|だいがく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}{形態|けいたい}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Triggered by the COVID pandemic, distance education spread rapidly and university class formats changed dramatically.

notes:
Refers to any form of education delivered to learners who are not physically in a classroom. Composed of {遠隔|えんかく} (remote, distant) + {教育|きょういく} (education). The concept existed before the internet via correspondence courses ({通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}), but gained massive attention during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}システム — distance education system
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}を{導入|どうにゅう}する — to introduce distance education
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}の{課題|かだい} — challenges of distance education
- {遠隔|えんかく}{教育|きょういく}{環境|かんきょう} — distance education environment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オンライン{授業|じゅぎょう} — online class (more casual, specific to internet-based)
- {通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく} — correspondence education (older format, by mail)
- eラーニング — e-learning (self-paced digital learning)
- {遠隔|えんかく}{授業|じゅぎょう} — remote class (focuses on individual classes rather than the system)
